title: Aston Martin The Americas: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED (67 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, WHEN A LOAD IS APPLIED ON THE PARKING INTERLOCK SYSTEM, THE LOCKING CONE, WHICH IS PART OF THE PARKING PAWL SYSTEM, MAY CREATE AN INDENTATION ON AN UNHARDENED GUIDE PLATE AT THE CONE CONTACT AREA.  AN INDENTATION MAY ALSO RESULT IN A RAISED EDGE TOWARDS THE LOCKING CONE GUIDE CHANNEL WHICH MAY HINDER THE LOCKING CONE FROM REACHING ITS END POSITION.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTORS (123 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MULTIPLEX MOTOR COACHES, THE WIPER MOTOR THERMAL PROTECTION IS STOPPING THE MOTOR WHEN THE WIPERS ARE FUNCTIONING FOR A LONG TIME IN SECOND SPEED.

title: SANTA FE VANS: CENTER HIGH MOUNTED STOP LAMP/FMVSS 108 (3 affected)
summary: CERTAIN CONVERSION VANS BUILT ON GMC/CHEVROLET CHASSIS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."  THE HOUSING LENS OF THE CENTER HIGH MOUNTED STOP LAMP DOES NOT ALLOW ENOUGH LIGHT TO EMIT FROM THE LAMP.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL TANK STRAP BREAKAGE (123,206 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE STRAPS THAT SECURE THE FUEL TANK TO THE VEHICLE BODY MAY BREAK, CAUSING THE FUEL TANK AND FUEL TANK HEAT SHIELD TO DROP ON THE DRIVESHAFT (ALL WHEEL DRIVE VEHICLES) OR EXHAUST SYSTEM (FRONT WHEEL DRIVE VEHICLES).

title: Ford Motor Company: POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE (98,836 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE BATTERY CABLE INCLUDES A FUSIBLE LINK THAT MAY CONTACT AND SUBSEQUENTLY CHAFE  ON A  #2 CROSS MEMBER ATTACHING BOLT.

title: Ford Motor Company: PARK PAWL GUIDE PLATE (289 affected)
summary: CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH AN INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION PARKING PAWL GUIDE PLATE.

title: Ford Motor Company: WIPER MOTOR GREASE (199,942 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS, PASSENGER CARS AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES, THE WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITHOUT GREASE BEING APPLIED TO THE OUTPUT SHAFT GEAR.

title: Ford Motor Company: CAB ENTRY STEP REINFORCEMENT (2,488 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MEDIUM DUTY CHASSIS CABS, THE CAB ENTRY STEP PLATFORMS ON EITHER SIDE OF THE VEHICLE MAY CRACK DURING NORMAL USE.

title: KTM North America, Inc.: FRONT WHEEL WEAR (443 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, PREMATURE WEAR ON THE FRONT WHEEL COMPONENTS CAN OCCUR.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: GALLEY COUNTERTOP KNIFE SHIELD (342 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES WITH THE OPTIONAL GALLEY UPGRADE PACKAGE, KNIVES STORED IN THE GALLEY KNIFE HOLDER MAY INTERFERE WITH THE PROPANE GAS LINE TO THE STOVE.

title: Erwin Hymer Group North America, Inc.: BBQ HOSE CONNECTORS (381 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN CLASS B MOTOR HOMES BUILT ON CHEVROLET CHASSIS AND EQUIPPED WITH PROPANE BBQ CONNECTION.  A RUBBER HOSE IS CONNECTED TO THE PROPANE REGULATOR AT ONE END AND HAS A BRASS SHUTOFF VALVE CONNECTOR ON THE OTHER "FREE END."   THE CLAMP USED FOR HOLDING THE BRASS BBQ SHUTOFF VALVE IS NOT INSERTED PROPERLY INTO ITS HOLDING CLAMP.

title: Foretravel, Inc.: TAG AXLE SPINDLE PLUGS MISSING (44 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES, THE SPINDLE PLUGS ON SOME TAG AXLES ARE MISSING.  THE BEARINGS AND RELATED SURFACES CAN BE CONTAMINATED WITH DEBRIS.

title: IC CORPORATION: FMVSS 121/AIR BRAKE SUPPLY TUBES (147 affected)
summary: CERTAIN 2006 IC RESB (PB305) AND RECB (PC305) SCHOOL AND COMMERCIAL BUSES MANUFACTURED FROM JULY 20 TO OCTOBER 17, 2005.   THE PRIMARY AND SECONDARY AIR SUPPLY TUBES FROM THE FOOT VALVE TO THE PRIMARY AND SECONDARY AIR TANKS WERE REVERSED AT THE TANK WHICH FAILS TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 121, AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: STUD PIN HOLE/SLOW AIR LOSS (4,080 affected)
summary: CERTAIN COOPER TIRE WHETHER-MASTER S/T2, SIZE 215/65R16, MANUFACTURED BETWEEN FEBRUARY 13 AND JUNE 4, 2005.  THERE IS IMPROPER DEPTH OF THE STUD PIN HOLD. A PROPERLY INSERTED METAL STUD PIN, OVER TIME, COULD PENETRATE INTO THE CARCASS AND CAUSE A GRADUAL REDUCTION IN INFLATION OF THE TIRE.

title: HEIL TRAILER INTERNATIONAL, CO: DUMP BODY HYDRAULIC CYLINDER FAILS (90 affected)
summary: CERTAIN DUMP TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH CUSTOM HEIL HOIST HYDRAULIC CYLINDERS.  WHILE IN USE, THE HOIST CAN FAIL, ALLOWING THE DUMP BODY TO ABRUPTLY FALL FROM THE "DUMP" POSITION ONTO THE CHASSIS.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: PASSENGER SEAT WIRING HARNESS (1,530 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, A WIRING HARNESS CONDITION EXISTS THAT MAY DEACTIVATE THE PASSENGER SIDE FRONTAL AIR BAG EVEN UNDER CIRCUMSTANCES WHEN IT SHOULD REMAIN ACTIVATED.

title: International Motors, LLC: CAB ENTRY STEP REINFORCEMENT (989 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS, THE CAB ENTRY STEPS WERE MANUFACTURED INCORRECTLY CAUSING THEM TO HAVE LOWER MATERIAL STRENGTH PROPERTIES THAN DESIGNED.  THESE LOWER MATERIAL STRENGTH PROPERTIES CAN ALLOW THE STEP TREAD TO FRACTURE AND SEPARATE FROM THE VEHICLE UNDER NORMAL USAGE.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: FUEL TANK MOUNTING (4,482 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN DIESEL POWERED HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS, THE BOLTS ATTACHING THE FUEL TANK MOUNTING BRACKETS TO THE FRAME MAY HAVE INSUFFICIENT TORQUE AND THEREFORE MAY RESULT IN PREMATURE FAILURE OF THE FUEL TANK MOUNTING.

title: Mazda North American Operations: WIPER MOTOR GREASE (3,982 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES, THE WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITHOUT GREASE APPLIED TO THE OUTPUT SHAFT GEAR.

title: HYUNDAI CARIBBEAN-PUERTO RICO: OCCUPANT CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM/FMVSS 208 (134 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH AN OCCUPANT CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM (OCS) THE RIGHT FRONT SEAT OF THE VEHICLE MAY MISCLASSIFY CERTAIN SMALL CHILDREN SEATED ON THE FRONT EDGE OF THE SEAT AS AN ADULT.

title: REV Ambulance Group Orlando, Inc.: TIRE INFORMATION LABEL/FMVSS 110 (110 affected)
summary: CERTAIN AMBULANCES BUILT ON FORD E350 AND CHEVROLET GMT610 VAN.  FAIL TO CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 110, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS." THESE AMBULANCES HAVE THE INCORRECT OR MISSING TIRE AND LOADING INFORMATION PLACARDS IN THE DRIVER'S DOOR JAMB.  THIS INFORMATION WILL AID IN LOADING THE AMBULANCE TO AVOID EXCEEDING THE GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATING.

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: BATTERY POSITIVE CABLE (10,259 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES, DUE TO AN ERROR IN THE FACTORY ASSEMBLY INSTRUCTION, THE B+TERMINAL MAY BE IN CONFLICT WITH THE STARTER MOTOR SOLENOID.  IF THIS OCCURS, THE CONFLICT BETWEEN THE B+TERMINAL AND THE STARTER MOTOR SOLENOID MAY DEVELOP INTO  A SHORT CIRCUIT OF THE BATTERY CABLE TO GROUND.

title: GRAND GENERAL ACC. & MFG.: FMVSS 108/STOP LAMP/LOW LIGHT OUTPUT (300 affected)
summary: CERTAIN GRAND GENERAL 4" SPYDER RED LED LIGHT ONLY, P/N 83883, STOP/TURN/TAIL LAMPS SOLD AS AFTERMARKET EQUIPMENT FOR VEHICLES GREATER THAN 80".  THE LIGHTS ARE DATE STAMPED ON THE DAY OF PRODUCTION AND CAN BE IDENTIFIED BY THE DATE STAMP "2004 APR 16" OR "2004 APR 17".  THESE LIGHTS HAVE BAD LIGHT OUTPUT CAUSED BY A LIMITING RESISTOR WHICH GIVES AN INCORRECT POWER CURRENT DRAW.  THESE LIGHTS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT.

title: Thor California, Inc.: SLIDEOUT SWITCH AND CIRCUIT BREAKER REPLACEMENT (387 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN FIFTH WHEEL TRAILERS, THERE IS A POSSIBILITY OF OVERLOADING THE SLIDEOUT RESETTABLE CIRCUIT BREAKER AND THE SLIDEOUT CONTROL SWITCH.

title: Cottrell, Inc.: ROOF BRACKETS (38 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN CAR HAUL TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH ROOFS THAT RAISE AND LOWER, THE ROOF IS ATTACHED TO A RAISING/LOWERING MECHANISM BY BRACKETS THAT ARE FASTENED TO THE ROOF.  THESE BRACKETS MAY EXPERIENCE HIGH STRESS DURING THE PROCESS OF SEATING THE ROOF IN THE DOWN POSITION, AND THAT THE FASTENERS USED TO SECURE THE ROOF TO THE BRACKETS MAY NOT BE ABLE TO WITHSTAND THOSE STRESSES.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: FMVSS 404/403 - WHEELCHAIR LIFT (9 affected)
summary: CERTAIN 2006 MY BLUE BIRD MICROBIRD SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH A WHEELCHAIR LIFT MANUFACTURED FROM JULY 1 AND NOVEMBER 14, 2005.  THE SHIFT INTERLOCK SYSTEM WAS NOT INSTALLED DURING PRODUCTION WHICH FAILS TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NOS. 403, "PLATFORM LIFT SYSTEMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES, AND 404, "PLATFORM LIFT INSTALLATIONS IN MOTOR VEHICLES."

title: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC: FMVSS 119/PREMATURE TIRE WEAR (34,396 affected)
summary: CERTAIN CONTINENTAL CONTITRAC TR OWL, CONTITRAC TR BSW, GENERAL GRABBER TR BSW, AND CONTITRAC BSW TIRES MANUFACTURED BETWEEN MAY 29 AND JUNE 11, 2005, AND SOLD AS ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT ON CERTAIN FORD TRUCKS AND SOLD AS REPLACEMENT TIRES.  THESE TIRES CAN WEAR PREMATURELY WHICH FAILS TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 119, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES FOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS.

title: Aprilia USA, Inc.: SWING ARM COMPONENTS (877 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, WHILE IN USE THE SWING ARM COMPONENT MAY DEVELOP A STRESS FRACTURE OVER AN EXTENDED PERIOD OF TIME.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: FALSE NEUTRAL TRANSMISSION (10,498 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, THE TRANSMISSION MAY GO INTO A FALSE NEUTRAL POSITION EVEN THOUGH THE NEUTRAL INDICATOR LIGHT IS ILLUMINATED.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: TIRE INFORMATION LABEL/FMVSS 110 (CAMRY) (4,503 affected)
summary: CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES FAIL TO CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 110,  "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS"   THE VEHICLES' TIRE AND LOADING INFORMATION LABEL OR PLACARD ON THE DRIVER'S SIDE B-PILLAR INCORRECTLY INDICATES THE SPARE TIRE SIZE.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: LOWER STEERING SHAFT (198 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH FONTAINE MODIFICATION RIGHT HAND STEERING CONTROL AND EQUIPPED WITH SIT DOWN DUAL DRIVE CONVERSIONS, THE PINCH BOLT THAT SECURES THE LOWER STEERING SHAFT CONNECTION TO THE LH MITER BOX MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY TORQUED CAUSING THE BOLTS TO FALL OUT.

title: ACCESSORIES MARKETING, INC.: TIRE PRESSURE INDICATOR VALVE CAP/AIR LOSS (42,204 affected)
summary: CERTAIN SLIME (ACCESSORIES MARKETING, INC.) TIRE PRESSURE INDICATOR VALVE CAPS (PIVC), P/NOS. 1013-A AND 1015-A, MANUFACTURED BETWEEN JANUARY 2004 AND AUGUST 2005 SOLD AS AFTERMARKET EQUIPMENT THROUGH AUTOZONE.   THE DEFECTIVE PIVCS CAN ALLOW AIR TO ESCAPE FROM THE TIRE, RESULTING IN A LOSS OF TIRE PRESSURE.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): TIRES (1,606 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE TIRES COULD HAVE BEEN DAMAGED WHEN THE TIRES WERE MOUNTED ON THE WHEELS.  IN CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES, THE BEAD AREA OF THE TIRE MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: ESP/STEERING COLUMN SHAFT ALIGNMENT (241 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH THE BENDIX ELECTRONIC STABILITY CONTROL (ESP) SYSTEM, THE SYSTEM USES MULTIPLE SENSORS AND AN ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT (ECU) TO CONTROL VEHICLE UNDER STEER, OVER-STEER, AND ROLLOVER SITUATIONS.  THE SYSTEM RELIES ON VEHICLE SENSORS TO BE FUNCTIONING AND ALIGNED PROPERLY.  THE STEERING ANGLE SENSOR HAS THE POTENTIAL TO BE MISALIGNED WITH THE STEERING COLUMN SHAFT, THEREBY PROVIDING INCORRECT INFORMATION TO THE BENDIX ECU.

title: Bentley Motors, Ltd.: FRONT SUSPENSION LOWER BALL JOINT NUT (80 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, DUE TO THE USE OF A NON SELF-LOCKING NUT, THE FRONT SUSPENSION LOWER BALL JOINT CAN BECOME DISCONNECTED.

title: Forest River, Inc.: LP GAS MANIFOLD/CRUSHED/FIRE (199 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN CLASS B MOTOR HOMES, IF THE AXLE BOTTOMS OUT AGAINST THE RUBBER SUSPENSION SNUBBERS, IT IS POSSIBLE THAT THE "U" BOLTS THAT HOLD THE SPRINGS TO THE REAR AXLE CAN PENETRATE THE STEEL TUBE AND COME INTO CONTACT WITH THE STEEL LIQUID PROPANE (LP) MANIFOLD.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: TIE ROD SECURING NUTS (15 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE LEFT AND RIGHT TIE ROD SECURING NUT MAY BE INSUFFICIENTLY TORQUED.

title: Hyundai Translead: TRAILER SUSPENSION/TRAILER WANDERS/TUTHILL (188 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VAN TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH  TUTHILL TRAILER SUSPENSIONS, MODELS 20/22 AND RS3162, THE BEAM/AXLE PIVOT CONNECTION JOINT IS MIS-ALIGNED CAUSING EXCESSIVE PLAY WITH THE TRAILER ALLOWING THE TRAILER TO WANDER.

title: Wabash National Corporation: TRAILER SUSPENSION/TRAILER WANDERS/TUTHILL (105 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN DRY VAN AND REEFER TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH  TUTHILL TRAILER SUSPENSIONS, MODELS 20/22, THE BEAM/AXLE PIVOT CONNECTION JOINT IS MIS-ALIGNED CAUSING EXCESSIVE PLAY WITH THE TRAILER ALLOWING THE TRAILER TO WANDER.

title: WELD-IT COMPANY: TRAILER SUSPENSION/TRAILER WANDERS/TUTHILL (89 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN FULL TRAILERS (TANKERS)  EQUIPPED WITH  TUTHILL TRAILER SUSPENSIONS, MODELS 20/22AR.  THE BEAM/AXLE PIVOT CONNECTION JOINT IS MIS-ALIGNED CAUSING EXCESSIVE PLAY WITH THE TRAILER ALLOWING THE TRAILER TO WANDER.

title: CPSC, American Greetings Corporation Announce Recall of Fairy Wand Party Favors
summary: The fairy wand party favors can break apart, exposing sharp wires that pose a laceration hazard to children. Units: About 14,200 packages, containing four wands each.

title: CPSC, Makita U.S.A. Inc. Announce Recall of Angle Grinders
summary: The guards on some of these angle grinders will not fully cover a hubbed grinding wheel. As a result, if the hubbed grinding wheel comes apart during use, it could hit the user, possibly causing serious personal injury. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, Watts Water Technologies, Inc. Announce Recall of Gas Ball Valves
summary: Gas can leak from these valves, posing a risk of fires and explosions. Units: 4,500.

title: CPSC, World Kitchen Inc. Announce Recall of Immersion Heaters
summary: Moisture in the heating element could cause corrosion over time, presenting a shock hazard. Units: About 472,000.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A. Announce Recall of Hedge Trimmers
summary: On some units, the engine mount springs between the gear case and handle/frame could separate from their receptacle in the frame during heavy operation. Continued use could cause the engine and blades to swing free of the frame and hit the user, possibly causing lacerations. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, Pottery Barn Outlet Announce Recall of Halloween Candleholders
summary: The recalled candleholders could allow tea lights to have a high flame. This poses a fire hazard and risk of burn injuries to consumers. This product was previously recalled by Pottery Barn on October 16, 2002. Units: About 900.

title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Tea Light Candles
summary: The recalled candles can burn with a high flame and melt the plastic holders. This poses a fire hazard and a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 290,000.

title: CPSC, Thane International Announce Recall of Perfect Air Ultra™ Air Purifiers
summary: An overheating capacitor in these air purifiers can cause arcing in a connecting wire, which poses the risk of fire. Units: About 35,000.

title: CPSC, Nikon Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Rechargeable Battery Packs Sold with Digital SLR Cameras
summary: These battery packs can short circuit, causing them to overheat and possibly melt, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 200,000 (About 710,000 worldwide).

title: CPSC, Yamaha Motor Corp., U.S.A. Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: The protective boots covering the steering system's tie-rod ends (universal joints) on the recalled ATVs could be pinched during installation or adjustment, cutting a hole in the rubber. If this occurs, grease could escape, and contaminants, such as sand or mud, could get into the assembly through t

title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Pillar Candles With Jewels
summary: The paint coating on the outside of the candle can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 17,000.

title: CPSC, Louisville Ladder Inc. Announce Recall of Industrial Ladders
summary: Rungs on the ladders could break near the side rail, causing the user to fall. Units: About 3,000.

title: CPSC, Delta Enterprise Corp. Announce Recall of Certain Cribs Sold at Toys R Us Stores
summary: The crib's paint contains high levels of lead. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems and growth retardation. Units: About 335.

title: CPSC, Haier America Trading LLC Announce Recall of Oscillating Electric Tower Fans
summary: Internal electrical arcing in the fan can cause a fire hazard. Units: About 150,000.

title: CPSC, International Playthings Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Vehicles
summary: Small parts can detach, which poses a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 6,000.

title: CPSC, International Playthings Inc. Announce Recall of Viking Chubbies Toy Cars
summary: The heads on the figures sold with the cars can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,900.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Sets
summary: Some of the toys in these trunks contain small parts, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 7,200 units.

title: CPSC, American Public Company Announce Recall of Boys' Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Sold by J.C. Penney
summary: The hooded sweatshirts have drawstrings, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 3,400.

title: CPSC, American Suzuki Motor Corp. Announce Recall of 2005 King Quad All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: Use of an improper tie rod adjustment procedure during assembly could lead to separation of the tie rod end housing from the attachment shaft. This could cause the rider to lose control of the ATV and result in injury or death. Units: About 19,600.

title: CPSC, Cooper Hand Tools Announce Recall of Weller® Heating Element used in Soldering Irons
summary: The housing of the heating element can unexpectedly leak hot metal, posing a serious risk of a burn injury to the user. Units: About 890.

title: CPSC, Retailers Announce Recall of Waterless Vaporizers and Aromatherapy Diffusers
summary: A defective internal heater in the recalled vaporizers and diffusers can cause sparking and emit flames while in use. This poses a fire, burn and shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000 Vaporizers and 5,000 Aromatherapy Diffusers.

title: CPSC, Southern Living At Home Announce Recall of Votive CandleHolders Included with Old Taylor Estate Candeliers
summary: These votive glass candle holders can break unexpectedly during use. Units: About 345,900 votive candle holders.

title: CPSC, Sycamore Kids Inc. Expands Recall of Mountain Buggy Jogging Strollers
summary: The handlebar can crack or break, causing the handlebar to detach while in use, posing a risk of injury to young children. Units: About 3,200.

title: CPSC, Stravina Operating Co. Announce Recall of Children's Metal Necklaces and Zipper Pulls
summary: The recalled metal jewelry contains high levels of accessible lead in the metal and/or the paint, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning to young children. Lead is toxic if ingested by children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 6 million.

title: CPSC, Porter-Cable Announce Recall to Repair Circular Saws
summary: The lower guard on these saws could stick in the open position, posing a risk of severe lacerations to consumers. Units: About 196,000 units.

title: CPSC, Yamaha Corporation of America Announce Recall of Synthesizers
summary: Unit could emit loud "white noise" when turned off and turned on again under high temperature conditions, which could possibly damage a consumer's hearing. Units: About 1,100.

title: CPSC, Sanus Systems Announce Recall of Television Wall Mounting Units
summary: An undersized shaft within the wall mounting unit can cause the product's main support component to loosen. As a result, the unit and the television it is supporting can fall from the wall, posing a risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 14,000.

title: CPSC, Starbucks Coffee Company Announce Recall of Ceramic Teapots
summary: The teapots are labeled safe for microwave use, but the handles can become hot in the microwave oven. This poses a possible burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 257.
